E0979

A `jet os` target has no host, or its `host@root` selector has an empty half.

What

A `jet os` target has no host, or its `host@root` selector has an empty half.

Why

D-JPK-REF1 amends D-JPK-OSHOST1: a bare host selects `system.<host>` in `./config.jet`; both halves of `host@root` are required for an external root.

Fix

Write `jet os switch laptop` or `jet os switch laptop@../machines`.
